query:
SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.description,
  e.categoryId,
  ec.name as categoryName,
  e.productId,
  e.lossQuantity,
  e.amount,
  e.paymentMethod,
  e.status,
  e.createdAt
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN expenseCategories ec ON e.categoryId = ec.id
WHERE ec.name = 'Perdas' OR e.description LIKE '%Perda%'
ORDER BY e.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
